Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: FastPay MAP: security intake & compliance timeline (weekly checkpoint)

Hi Sarah —

Following up with this week's MAP checkpoint and a short status update on the security/compliance asks we outlined. Attached is an updated MAP (FastPay_MAP-v2.xlsx) with the timeline and owners column filled where we've confirmed owners. High-level: we're tracking to the planned close in mid-February but a couple of items need FastPay input to avoid slipping the timeline.

Quick summary (owners in parentheses):
- SOC 2 report: FastPay to share latest Type II report or interim report (FastPay SOC) — target receipt by 02/02
- DPA signature: Procurement to confirm countersign timeline; Redwood will prepare redline-ready DPA and send DocuSign (Jordan) — target signature by 02/09
- Audit logs access: Clarify log retention window (FastPay SOC) and whether S3 access or signed export needed (Monica) — action: FastPay to confirm export format and retention
- Pen test asks: scope + proof-of-issue remediation plan (FastPay security) — FastPay to provide planned pen-test window and sample remediation evidence (Mina)
- Evidence collection: Redwood will prepare an evidence bundle checklist and request specific artifacts after we get the SOC/DPA items (Jordan/Monica)

Action items for this week (from MAP tab 'Week 3'):
1) FastPay to attach SOC 2 interim or latest report to this thread (owner: FastPay SOC) — due 02/02
2) Procurement: confirm PO/DPA process and expected sign date (owner: Procurement) — due 01/26
3) FastPay security: confirm pen-test window and provide scope PDF (owner: FastPay security) — due 01/22
4) Redwood: send DPA via DocuSign and map redlines if any (owner: Jordan) — in progress

If any of these dates look unrealistic, please push back with the earliest available date and we'll adjust the MAP. We'll keep the weekly sync on Thursdays, but can move if procurement requires a separate cadence.

Attachments: FastPay_MAP-v2.xlsx (map with owners and burndown), pen-test-ask-list.xlsx (asks we would need post-pen test)

Thanks —
Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Exec, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@fastpay.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@fastpay.com>, FastPay SOC <soc@fastpay.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FastPay MAP: security intake & compliance timeline (weekly checkpoint)

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear breakdown. A couple of quick clarifications and updates from our side:

- SOC 2: we don't have a Type II completed for the new payments connector yet; we can provide our last Type II (platform-level) and an interim controls attestation for the connector by 02/01. I'll upload the platform report to this thread by EOD 02/01.
- DPA/Procurement: procurement is aiming to complete initial review this week. They asked for a copy of the DPA with any non-standard clauses flagged. Procurement indicated an internal sign window of 7–10 business days after we receive the final DPA (so 02/09 is possible if redlines are minimal).
- Pen test: attached the pen-test scope doc we usually share (fastpay-pen-test-scope.pdf). Our security team is tentatively scheduling external pen testing 02/14–02/16; however, remediation evidence timelines vary depending on findings.
- Audit logs: we retain 12 months of detailed logs; we can provide S3 export access to a signed bucket with pre-signed URLs for specific time ranges. Our SOC contact can provide the S3 path and a short readme.

We'll aim to get the SOC artifacts and S3 details uploaded by 02/01. If Redwood needs a proof-of-concept export, let us know the preferred format (gzipped JSON or parquet).

Regards,
Sarah Lim
Head of GTM Security Operations, FastPay
sarah.lim@fastpay.com

Monica will take the lead on S3 export verification — Monica, can you confirm what access you need (pre-signed URL vs. IAM role)?
- Pen test: Mina will own the post-pen-test remediation validation. Mina, please prepare a short template we can ask FastPay to fill per finding (remediation date + evidence link).

1) DocuSign DPA -> Jordan (in flight)
2) Evidence checklist -> Karthik/Monica (target 01/25)
3) Pen-test validation template -> Mina (target 01/24)
